name: Ethereal Guard reduces party/raid damage taken and hastes the Reaper
contract: Ethereal Guard 300969 promises party/raid members take 3% less damage, and the caster gains 10% melee haste. EFFECT_0 is native SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) with EffectApplyAuraName SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN (87), EffectBasePoints -4 + DieSides 1 = -3 (3% reduction). EFFECT_1 is native SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA (6) with SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_HASTE (138), EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10. Both auras and their targeting are core-handled with no CoA registration required; #3913's zero-hits-in-source is expected here.

steps.label: Ethereal Guard spread to the party member
The raid buff reduces damage taken by 3%
The caster also gains 10% melee haste
